requirement_ref.quote: The sign-in form offers a "stay signed in" option.

test_objective: Choosing to stay signed in keeps the session alive across a browser restart.
preconditions: the account exists and is in good standing

test_data.name: known_account
test_data.description: a registered account in good standing whose password is known to the test

steps.actor_intent: arrive at the sign-in screen as an unauthenticated visitor
sign in with valid credentials, choosing to stay signed in
close the browser entirely and return to the application

outcomes.statement: The user is still signed in and reaches their dashboard without signing in again.

not_verifiable_yet: That the session actually lasts the full window assumed in Q-3. A smoke run proves the session survives a restart; it cannot sit for 30 days, and no clock the test controls has been agreed.
